leadText:
Shroomish Forest (Japanese: キノココの森 Forest) is an -exclusive forest in Hoenn. It is located somewhere between Littleroot Town and Fortree City. It was featured in A Shroomish Skirmish.

A starving resorted to stealing some of the 's fruit. The Mushroom Pokémon were incredibly angered by this and went on to evolve into . While and were enjoying a break, the trio ran into them with the rampaging Breloom closely behind. After the Breloom unleashed a combined , everyone was separated into smaller groups.

Max, , May's Torchic, and Ash's Corphish eventually stumbled upon a fruit pile and the Shroomish territory. Another battle ensued, and eventually, everyone was reunited. In an act of defiance, Torchic stood up to a Breloom in a bid to protect Corphish and evolved into in the process. Combusken then took on the Breloom in a hand-to-hand combat match, which ended in a draw and the two Pokémon came to respect each other.

The area is densely forested, and also features deep ravines and gorges.
